commitResults.messageTitle: Refactor Java classes to follow standard
commitResults.messageBody:
The Java classes lack project packages, encapsulated state, consistent formatting, and the required public API documentation.

Apply the SE-EDU Java coding standard by organizing classes under the ip package, hiding mutable fields, adding Javadocs, and normalizing control flow and spacing.

This improves readability, maintainability, and consistency with the project's coding requirements.

The project guidance does not define reusable Java and Git standards for future work.

Add project-specific skills for SE-EDU Java and Git conventions, and require those skills from AGENTS.md.

This gives future changes a single, discoverable source of project standards.

CLAUDE.md does not explicitly require the project-specific Java and Git standards.

Require both standards in the file so future Claude-assisted work follows the same project rules.

This keeps agent guidance consistent across supported instruction files.

The unmark command changes a task's status without confirming the result to the user.

Restore the confirmation message after marking a task as not done.

This keeps the unmark command consistent with the mark command and gives users clear feedback that the requested change succeeded.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add support for todo, deadline, and event tasks
commitResults.messageBody: Track task types and display optional deadline or event date/time details.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add inheritance for different task types
commitResults.messageBody: Support polymorphic Todo, Deadline, and Event tasks with type-specific output.

Extract command-loop, task-list, and task-state handling from the
application entry point. Keep each method focused on one responsibility so
future command changes are easier to understand and less likely to affect
unrelated startup or input behavior.
